import collections
import math

string uppercase_letters()
    return "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ"

string lowercase_letters()
    return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"

string decimal_digits()
    return "0123456789"

enum Style
    APA
    IEEE
    Chicago
    MLA

string[] known_fields()
    return "author editor title journal booktitle edition volume number pages publisher institution school address howpublished month year doi note".split(" ")

string[] entry_types()
    return "article book inproceedings incollection techreport phdthesis misc".split(" ")

string[] required_fields(string kind)
    if kind == "article"
        return ["author", "title", "journal", "year"]
    if kind == "book"
        return ["author", "title", "publisher", "year"]
    if kind == "inproceedings"
        return ["author", "title", "booktitle", "year"]
    if kind == "incollection"
        return ["author", "title", "booktitle", "publisher", "year"]
    if kind == "techreport"
        return ["author", "title", "institution", "year"]
    if kind == "phdthesis"
        return ["author", "title", "school", "year"]
    return ["author", "title", "year"]

string[] months()
    return "January February March April May June July August September October November December".split(" ")

bool includes<T>(const T[] values, T sought)
    for item := values[]
        if item == sought
            return true
    return false

int find_index(string text, string needle)
    match text.find(needle)
        nat position
            return int(position)
        none
            return -1

string map_text(const map<string, string> fields, string name)
    match fields.get(name)
        string value
            return value
        none
            return ""

int map_count(const map<string, int> counts, string key)
    match counts.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

bool letter(string character)
    return #character == 1 and (uppercase_letters() + lowercase_letters()).contains(character)

bool all_digits(string text)
    if #text == 0
        return false
    for: index < #text
        if not decimal_digits().contains(text[index])
            return false
    return true

string letter_case(string text, bool upper)
    result := ""
    int[] points := text.codepoints()
    for: index < #points
        point := points[index]
        if upper and 97 <= point <= 122
            result += uppercase_letters()[point - 97]
        elif not upper and 65 <= point <= 90
            result += lowercase_letters()[point - 65]
        else
            result += text[index]
    return result

string plain(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        if text[index] != "{{" and text[index] != "}}"
            result += text[index]
    return result

string letters_only(string text)
    result := ""
    for: index < #text
        if letter(text[index])
            result += text[index]
    return letter_case(result, false)

bool small_word(string text)
    return includes("a an and as at but by for from in into nor of on or over per so the to up via with yet".split(" "), text)

string[] split_depth(string text, string delimiter)
    string[] parts := []
    depth := 0
    start := 0
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        if depth == 0 and text[position:].starts_with(delimiter)
            parts = parts.append(text[start:<position])
            position += int(#delimiter)
            start = position
        else
            if text[position] == "{{"
                depth += 1
            elif text[position] == "}}"
                depth -= 1
            position += 1
    return parts.append(text[start:])

string | error evaluate(string expression, const map<string, string> macros)
    depth := 0
    for: index < #expression
        if expression[index] == "{{"
            depth += 1
        elif expression[index] == "}}"
            depth -= 1
        if depth < 0
            return error("unbalanced braces")
    if depth != 0
        return error("unbalanced braces")
    result := ""
    for term := expression.split(" # ")[]
        if term.starts_with("{{") or term.starts_with(DQ)
            result += term[1:<int(#term) - 1]
        elif all_digits(term)
            result += term
        else
            match macros.get(term)
                string value
                    result += value
                none
                    return error("unknown macro '{term}'")
    return result

class Accent(string character, int width)

Accent | none accent_at(string text, int position)
    if position + 1 >= int(#text) or text[position] != "\"
        return none
    command := text[position + 1]
    if command == "&"
        return Accent("&", 2)
    bool symbol := ("'`^~=." + DQ).contains(command)
    if symbol and position + 2 < int(#text) and letter(text[position + 2])
        return Accent(text[position + 2], 3)
    if (symbol or "cuvH".contains(command)) and position + 4 < int(#text)
        if text[position + 2] == "{{" and letter(text[position + 3]) and text[position + 4] == "}}"
            return Accent(text[position + 3], 5)
    return none

string normalize(string text)
    result := ""
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        wrapped := false
        if text[position] == "{{"
            match accent_at(text, position + 1)
                Accent enclosed
                    closing := position + enclosed.width + 1
                    if closing < int(#text) and text[closing] == "}}"
                        result += enclosed.character
                        position = closing + 1
                        wrapped = true
                none
                    wrapped = false
        if wrapped
            continue
        match accent_at(text, position)
            Accent found
                result += found.character
                position += found.width
            none
                result += if text[position] == "~" then " " else text[position]
                position += 1
    string[] words := []
    for word := result.split(" ")[]
        if word != ""
            words = words.append(word)
    return words.join(" ")

class Person(first := "", von := "", last := "", junior := "")

class NameList(Person[] names := [], etal := false)

Person parse_person(string text)
    string[] parts := [for part := split_depth(text, ",")[] then part.trim()]
    words := split_depth(parts[0], " ")
    int[] lowercase := []
    for: 0 <= index < int(#words) - 1
        if lowercase_letters().contains(words[index][0])
            lowercase = lowercase.append(index)
    person := Person()
    if #parts == 1
        start := if #lowercase == 0 then int(#words) - 1 else lowercase[0]
        finish := if #lowercase == 0 then start else lowercase[-1] + 1
        person.first = words[0:<start].join(" ")
        person.von = words[start:<finish].join(" ")
        person.last = words[finish:].join(" ")
    else
        finish := if #lowercase == 0 then 0 else lowercase[-1] + 1
        person.von = words[0:<finish].join(" ")
        person.last = words[finish:].join(" ")
        person.first = parts[-1]
        if #parts == 3
            person.junior = parts[1]
    return person

NameList parse_names(string text)
    parts := split_depth(text, " and ")
    etal := parts[-1] == "others"
    if etal
        parts = parts[0:<int(#parts) - 1]
    return NameList([for part := parts[] then parse_person(part)], etal)

bool singular(const NameList names)
    return #names.names == 1 and not names.etal

string surname(const Person person)
    return plain((if person.von == "" then "" else person.von + " ") + person.last)

string initials(string given)
    unprotected := plain(given)
    if unprotected == ""
        return ""
    string[] result := []
    for word := unprotected.split(" ")[]
        string[] pieces := []
        for piece := word.split("-")[]
            letters := letters_only(piece)
            pieces = pieces.append(letter_case(letters[0], true) + ".")
        result = result.append(pieces.join("-"))
    return result.join(" ")

string name_text(const Person person, bool inverted, bool abbreviated)
    given := if abbreviated then initials(person.first) else plain(person.first)
    result := surname(person)
    if person.first != ""
        result = if inverted then result + ", " + given else given + " " + result
    if person.junior != ""
        result += ", " + plain(person.junior)
    return result

class Entry(string key, string kind, map<string, string> fields)
    primary := NameList()
    NameList | none editors := none
    sort_title := ""
    bibliography_key := ""
    suffix := ""

string field(const Entry entry, string name)
    return map_text(entry.fields, name)

Entry make_entry(string key, string kind, const map<string, string> fields)
    entry := Entry(key, kind, fields)
    if fields.has("editor")
        entry.editors = parse_names(map_text(fields, "editor"))
    entry.primary = parse_names(map_text(fields, if fields.has("author") then "author" else "editor"))
    entry.sort_title = letter_case(plain(field(entry, "title")), false)
    for article := ["a ", "an ", "the "][]
        if entry.sort_title.starts_with(article)
            entry.sort_title = entry.sort_title[int(#article):]
            break
    entry.bibliography_key = letter_case(plain(entry.primary.names[0].last), false) + HT + plain(field(entry, "year")) + HT + entry.sort_title + HT + key
    return entry

int[] ordered_entries(const Entry[] entries, const int[] indices, title_only := false)
    map<string, int> positions
    for index := indices[]
        string key := if title_only then entries[index].sort_title + HT + entries[index].key else entries[index].bibliography_key
        .positions.set(key, index)
    return [for key := positions.keys().sorted()[] then map_count(positions, key)]

class Database()
    Entry[] entries := []
    lookup := map<string, int>()
    int[] bibliography := []
    int[] record := []

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

Database read_database(const string[] lines)
    database := Database()
    map<string, string> macros
    macro_names := "jan feb mar apr may jun jul aug sep oct nov dec".split(" ")
    month_values := months()
    for: index < #macro_names
        .macros.set(macro_names[index], month_values[index])
    errors := 0
    position := 0
    while position < int(#lines)
        line := lines[position]
        if line == "" or line.starts_with("%")
            position += 1
            continue
        error_line := position + 1
        reason := ""
        name := ""
        if line.starts_with("@string{{")
            separator := find_index(line, " = ")
            name = line[8:<separator]
            expression := line[separator + 3:<int(#line) - 1]
            match evaluate(expression, macros)
                string value
                    if macros.has(name)
                        reason = "duplicate macro"
                    else
                        .macros.set(name, value)
                error problem
                    reason = problem.message
        else
            opening := find_index(line, "{{")
            kind := line[1:<opening]
            name = line[opening + 1:<int(#line) - 1]
            map<string, string> fields
            if not includes(entry_types(), kind)
                reason = "unknown type '{kind}'"
            elif database.lookup.has(name)
                reason = "duplicate key"
            position += 1
            while lines[position] != "}}"
                if reason == ""
                    field_line := lines[position]
                    separator := find_index(field_line, " = ")
                    field_name := field_line[2:<separator]
                    finish := int(#field_line) - (if field_line.ends_with(",") then 1 else 0)
                    match evaluate(field_line[separator + 3:<finish], macros)
                        string value
                            if fields.has(field_name)
                                reason = "duplicate field '{field_name}'"
                            else
                                .fields.set(field_name, normalize(value))
                        error problem
                            reason = problem.message
                    if reason != ""
                        error_line = position + 1
                position += 1
            if reason == ""
                for required := required_fields(kind)[]
                    if fields.has(required) or (kind == "book" and required == "author" and fields.has("editor"))
                        continue
                    reason = "missing field '{required}'"
                    error_line = position + 1
                    break
            if reason == ""
                .database.lookup.set(name, int(#database.entries))
                database.entries = database.entries.append(make_entry(name, kind, fields))
        if reason != ""
            errors += 1
            emit("ERROR line {error_line}: {name}: {reason}")
        position += 1
    emit("LOADED entries={#database.entries} macros={macros.size() - 12} errors={errors}")
    database.bibliography = ordered_entries(database.entries, [for index := (nat(0):<#database.entries)[] then int(index)])
    assigned := array(#database.entries, fill = false)
    for: index < #database.entries
        if assigned[index]
            continue
        int[] group := []
        for: candidate < #database.entries
            if database.entries[index].primary == database.entries[candidate].primary and field(database.entries[index], "year") == field(database.entries[candidate], "year")
                group = group.append(int(candidate))
                assigned[candidate] = true
        if #group > 1
            group = ordered_entries(database.entries, group, true)
            for: suffix_index < #group
                database.entries[group[suffix_index]].suffix = lowercase_letters()[suffix_index]
    return database

string list_names(const string[] names, string conjunction, list_b := false)
    if #names == 1
        return names[0]
    if list_b and #names == 2
        return "{names[0]} {conjunction} {names[1]}"
    return names[0:<int(#names) - 1].join(", ") + ", " + conjunction + " " + names[-1]

string author_names(const NameList list, Style style)
    string[] forms := []
    for: index < #list.names
        inverted := style == Style.APA or ((style == Style.Chicago or style == Style.MLA) and index == 0)
        forms = forms.append(name_text(list.names[index], inverted, style == Style.APA or style == Style.IEEE))
    if style == Style.APA
        if list.etal
            return forms.join(", ") + ", et al."
        if #forms >= 21
            return forms[0:<19].join(", ") + ", . . . " + forms[-1]
        return list_names(forms, "&")
    if style == Style.IEEE
        return if list.etal or #forms >= 7 then forms[0] + " et al." else list_names(forms, "and", true)
    if style == Style.Chicago
        return if list.etal or #forms >= 11 then forms[0:<math.min(7, int(#forms))].join(", ") + ", et al." else list_names(forms, "and")
    return if list.etal or #forms >= 3 then forms[0] + ", et al." else list_names(forms, "and")

string editor_names(const NameList list, Style style)
    forms := [for person := list.names[] then name_text(person, false, style == Style.APA or style == Style.IEEE)]
    return if list.etal then forms[0] + " et al." else list_names(forms, if style == Style.APA then "&" else "and", true)

string year_label(const Entry entry, Style style)
    return plain(field(entry, "year")) + (if style == Style.APA or style == Style.Chicago then entry.suffix else "")

string convert_outside(string text, int mode)
    result := ""
    depth := 0
    first_letter := true
    for: index < #text
        character := text[index]
        if letter(character)
            if depth == 0
                if mode == 0
                    character = letter_case(character, false)
                elif mode == 1
                    upper := index == 0 or (index >= 2 and text[index - 2:<index] == ": ")
                    character = letter_case(character, upper)
                elif first_letter
                    character = letter_case(character, true)
            first_letter = false
        if character == "{{"
            depth += 1
        elif character == "}}"
            depth -= 1
        result += character
    return result

string title_text(string title, Style style)
    if style == Style.IEEE
        return plain(title)
    if style == Style.APA
        return plain(convert_outside(title, 1))
    words := split_depth(title, " ")
    string[] converted := []
    for: index < #words
        word := words[index]
        if not word.starts_with("{{")
            small := index > 0 and index + 1 < #words and not words[index - 1].ends_with(":") and small_word(letters_only(word))
            word = convert_outside(word, if small then 0 else 2)
        converted = converted.append(word)
    return plain(converted.join(" "))

int style_index(Style style)
    return if style == Style.APA then 0 elif style == Style.IEEE then 1 elif style == Style.Chicago then 2 else 3

string template_source(Style style, string kind)
    templates := [
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}). {{title}}. {{journal}}<, {{volume}}<({{number}})>><, {{pages}}>.< https://doi.org/{{doi}}>",
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}). {{title}}< ({{edition}})>. {{publisher}}.",
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}). {{title}}. In <{{editor}} ({{eds}}), >{{booktitle}}< ({{pp}})>.< {{publisher}}.>",
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}). {{title}}< (Report No. {{number}})>. {{institution}}.",
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}). {{title}} [Doctoral dissertation, {{school}}].",
        "{{author}}. ({{year}}<, {{month}}>). {{title}}.< {{howpublished}}.>< {{note}}.>",
        "{{author}}, {DQ}{{title}},{DQ} {{journal}}<, vol. {{volume}}><, no. {{number}}><, {{pp}}>, <{{mon}} >{{year}}<, doi: {{doi}}>.",
        "{{author}}, {{title}}<, {{edition}}>. <{{address}}: >{{publisher}}, {{year}}.",
        "{{author}}, {DQ}{{title}},{DQ} in {{booktitle}}<, {{editor}}, {{eds}}><, {{address}}><, {{publisher}}>, {{year}}<, {{pp}}>.",
        "{{author}}, {DQ}{{title}},{DQ} {{institution}}<, {{address}}>, Tech. Rep.< {{number}}>, {{year}}.",
        "{{author}}, {DQ}{{title}},{DQ} Ph.D. dissertation, {{school}}<, {{address}}>, {{year}}.",
        "{{author}}, {DQ}{{title}},{DQ}< {{howpublished}},> <{{mon}} >{{year}}.< {{note}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {DQ}{{title}}.{DQ} {{journal}}< {{volume}}>< ({{number}})><: {{pages}}>.< https://doi.org/{{doi}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {{title}}.< {{edition}}.> <{{address}}: >{{publisher}}.",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {DQ}{{title}}.{DQ} In {{booktitle}}<, edited by {{editor}}><, {{pages}}>.< <{{address}}: >{{publisher}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {{title}}. Technical Report< {{number}}>. <{{address}}: >{{institution}}.",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {DQ}{{title}}.{DQ} PhD diss., {{school}}.",
        "{{author}}. {{year}}. {{title}}.< {{howpublished}}.>< {{note}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {DQ}{{title}}.{DQ} {{journal}}<, vol. {{volume}}><, no. {{number}}>, <{{mon}} >{{year}}<, {{pp}}>.< https://doi.org/{{doi}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {{title}}.< {{edition}},> {{publisher}}, {{year}}.",
        "{{author}}. {DQ}{{title}}.{DQ} {{booktitle}},< edited by {{editor}},>< {{publisher}},> {{year}}<, {{pp}}>.",
        "{{author}}. {{title}}. {{institution}}, {{year}}.< Technical Report {{number}}.>",
        "{{author}}. {{title}}. {{year}}. {{school}}, PhD dissertation.",
        "{{author}}. {{title}}.< {{howpublished}},> <{{mon}} >{{year}}.< {{note}}.>",
    ]
    category := if kind == "article" then 0 elif kind == "book" then 1 elif kind == "inproceedings" or kind == "incollection" then 2 elif kind == "techreport" then 3 elif kind == "phdthesis" then 4 else 5
    return templates[6 * style_index(style) + category]

int optional_end(string source, int start)
    depth := 1
    position := start + 1
    while depth > 0
        if source[position] == "<"
            depth += 1
        elif source[position] == ">"
            depth -= 1
        position += 1
    return position - 1

bool optional_present(string source, int start, int finish, const map<string, string> values)
    position := start
    while position < finish
        if source[position] == "<"
            position = optional_end(source, position)
        elif source[position] == "{{"
            closing := position + find_index(source[position:], "}}")
            if map_text(values, source[position + 1:<closing]) == ""
                return false
            position = closing
        position += 1
    return true

void render_template(string source, int start, int finish, const map<string, string> values, string &result)
    position := start
    while position < finish
        character := source[position]
        if character == "<"
            closing := optional_end(source, position)
            if optional_present(source, position + 1, closing, values)
                render_template(source, position + 1, closing, values, &result)
            position = closing
        elif character == "{{"
            closing := position + find_index(source[position:], "}}")
            result += map_text(values, source[position + 1:<closing])
            position = closing
        elif character != "." or #result == 0 or not ".?!".contains(result[#result - 1])
            result += character
        position += 1

string edition_text(string text)
    if not all_digits(text)
        return text + " ed."
    value := int(text)
    last := value % 10
    suffix := if 11 <= value % 100 <= 13 then "th" elif last == 1 then "st" elif last == 2 then "nd" elif last == 3 then "rd" else "th"
    return "{value}{suffix} ed."

string reference(const Entry entry, Style style, int number, repeated := false)
    map<string, string> values
    for name := known_fields()[]
        .values.set(name, plain(field(entry, name)))
    .values.set("eds", "")
    .values.set("pp", "")
    .values.set("mon", "")
    author := if repeated then "---" else author_names(entry.primary, style)
    if not entry.fields.has("author")
        labels := [" (Ed.)", " (Eds.)", ", Ed.", ", Eds.", ", ed.", ", eds.", ", editor", ", editors"]
        author += labels[2 * style_index(style) + (if singular(entry.primary) then 0 else 1)]
    .values.set("author", author)
    match entry.editors
        NameList editors
            .values.set("editor", editor_names(editors, style))
            .values.set("eds", if singular(editors) then "Ed." else "Eds.")
        none
            .values.set("editor", "")
    .values.set("title", title_text(field(entry, "title"), style))
    .values.set("year", year_label(entry, style))
    if entry.fields.has("pages")
        pages := plain(field(entry, "pages")).split("--").join("-")
        .values.set("pages", pages)
        .values.set("pp", (if pages.contains("-") then "pp. " else "p. ") + pages)
    if entry.fields.has("edition")
        .values.set("edition", edition_text(plain(field(entry, "edition"))))
    month := plain(field(entry, "month"))
    month_names := months()
    abbreviations := ["Jan.", "Feb.", "Mar.", "Apr.", "May", "June", "July", "Aug.", "Sep.", "Oct.", "Nov.", "Dec."]
    for: index < #month_names
        if month == month_names[index]
            month = abbreviations[index]
            break
    .values.set("mon", month)
    source := template_source(style, entry.kind)
    result := if style == Style.IEEE then "[{number}] " else ""
    render_template(source, 0, int(#source), values, &result)
    return result

class Ranking(int[] order, int[] numbers)

Ranking ieee_order(const Database database)
    order := database.record
    for key := database.lookup.keys().sorted()[]
        index := map_count(database.lookup, key)
        if not includes(order, index)
            order = order.append(index)
    numbers := array(#database.entries, fill = 0)
    for: index < #order
        numbers[order[index]] = int(index) + 1
    return Ranking(order, numbers)

string short_name(const Entry entry, Style style, bool parenthetical)
    names := [for person := entry.primary.names[] then surname(person)]
    threshold := if style == Style.Chicago then 4 else 3
    if entry.primary.etal or int(#names) >= threshold
        return names[0] + " et al."
    return list_names(names, if style == Style.APA and parenthetical then "&" else "and", true)

enum CitationKind
    Parenthetical
    Narrative
    Author
    Year

class Citation(int start, int finish, CitationKind kind, int[] entries)

string citation_text(const Database database, const Citation citation, Style style, const int[] numbers)
    parenthetical := citation.kind == CitationKind.Parenthetical
    string[] pieces := []
    if citation.kind == CitationKind.Author or citation.kind == CitationKind.Year or style == Style.MLA or (style == Style.IEEE and not parenthetical)
        for index := citation.entries[]
            entry := database.entries[index]
            text := if citation.kind == CitationKind.Year then year_label(entry, style) else short_name(entry, style, false)
            if style == Style.IEEE and citation.kind == CitationKind.Narrative
                text += " [{numbers[index]}]"
            pieces = pieces.append(text)
        result := pieces.join(if citation.kind == CitationKind.Year then ", " else "; ")
        return if style == Style.MLA and parenthetical then "({result})" else result
    if style == Style.IEEE
        sorted := [for index := citation.entries[] then numbers[index]]
        sorted = sorted.sorted()
        position := 0
        while position < int(#sorted)
            finish := position + 1
            while finish < int(#sorted) and sorted[finish] == sorted[finish - 1] + 1
                finish += 1
            if finish - position >= 3
                pieces = pieces.append("[{sorted[position]}]-[{sorted[finish - 1]}]")
            else
                for: position <= index < finish
                    pieces = pieces.append("[{sorted[index]}]")
            position = finish
        return pieces.join(", ")
    entries := if parenthetical then ordered_entries(database.entries, citation.entries) else citation.entries
    position := 0
    while position < int(#entries)
        name := short_name(database.entries[entries[position]], style, parenthetical)
        finish := position + 1
        while finish < int(#entries) and short_name(database.entries[entries[finish]], style, parenthetical) == name
            finish += 1
        years := [for index := (int(position):<int(finish))[] then year_label(database.entries[entries[index]], style)]
        text := if parenthetical then name + (if style == Style.APA then ", " else " ") + years.join(", ") else name + " (" + years.join(", ") + ")"
        pieces = pieces.append(text)
        position = finish
    result := pieces.join("; ")
    return if parenthetical then "({result})" else result

string | error cite(Database &database, Style style, string text)
    Citation[] citations := []
    position := 0
    while position < int(#text)
        offset := find_index(text[position:], "\")
        if offset < 0
            break
        start := position + offset
        opening := start + find_index(text[start:], "{{")
        closing := opening + find_index(text[opening:], "}}")
        name := text[start + 1:<opening]
        CitationKind kind := if name == "citet" then CitationKind.Narrative elif name == "citeauthor" then CitationKind.Author elif name == "citeyear" then CitationKind.Year else CitationKind.Parenthetical
        int[] entries := []
        for key := text[opening + 1:<closing].split(",")[]
            if not database.lookup.has(key)
                return error("unknown key '{key}'")
            index := map_count(database.lookup, key)
            if not includes(entries, index)
                entries = entries.append(index)
        citations = citations.append(Citation(start, closing + 1, kind, entries))
        position = closing + 1
    for item := citations[]
        for index := item.entries[]
            if not includes(database.record, index)
                database.record = database.record.append(index)
    ranking := ieee_order(database)
    result := ""
    position = 0
    for item := citations[]
        result += text[position:<item.start] + citation_text(database, item, style, ranking.numbers)
        position = item.finish
    return result + text[position:]

void increment(map<string, int> &counts, string key)
    .counts.set(key, map_count(counts, key) + 1)

string base_key(const Entry entry)
    result := letters_only(plain(entry.primary.names[0].last))
    year := field(entry, "year")
    for: index < #year
        if decimal_digits().contains(year[index])
            result += year[index]
    for word := plain(field(entry, "title")).split(" ")[]
        letters := letters_only(word)
        if letters != "" and not small_word(letters)
            result += letters
            break
    return result

string key_suffix(int ordinal)
    if ordinal < 26
        return lowercase_letters()[ordinal]
    point := 97 + ordinal
    int[] octets := if point < 128 then [point] else [192 + point / 64, 128 + point % 64]
    bits := ""
    for octet := octets[]
        for: 7 >= place >= 0 step -1
            bits += if octet / (2 ^ place) % 2 == 0 then "0" else "1"
    bin encoded := bin(bits)
    return string.from_utf8(encoded)

void keygen(const Database database)
    bases := [for entry := database.entries[] then base_key(entry)]
    map<string, int> counts
    map<string, int> used
    for base := bases[]
        increment(&counts, base)
    for: index < #bases
        base := bases[index]
        suffix := if map_count(counts, base) > 1 then key_suffix(map_count(used, base)) else ""
        increment(&used, base)
        emit(database.entries[index].key + " -> " + base + suffix)

string[] unknown_fields(const Entry entry)
    string[] unknown := []
    for name := entry.fields.keys()[]
        if not includes(known_fields(), name)
            unknown = unknown.append(name)
    return unknown.sorted()

void check_entries(const Database database)
    warnings := 0
    map<string, string> seen_titles
    for entry := database.entries[]
        string[] messages := []
        if entry.fields.has("pages")
            pages := plain(field(entry, "pages"))
            if pages.contains("-") and not pages.contains("--")
                messages = messages.append("pages use a single hyphen")
            string[] parts := []
            for part := pages.split("-")[]
                if part != ""
                    parts = parts.append(part)
            if #parts == 2 and all_digits(parts[0]) and all_digits(parts[1])
                if int(parts[0]) > int(parts[1])
                    messages = messages.append("pages are reversed")
        year := plain(field(entry, "year"))
        if #year != 4 or not all_digits(year)
            messages = messages.append("year is not 4 digits")
        title := plain(field(entry, "title"))
        has_lowercase := false
        capitals := 0
        for: index < #title
            if lowercase_letters().contains(title[index])
                has_lowercase = true
            elif uppercase_letters().contains(title[index])
                capitals += 1
        if not has_lowercase and capitals >= 2
            messages = messages.append("title is all caps")
        if entry.kind == "article" and not entry.fields.has("doi")
            messages = messages.append("article has no doi")
        title_key := letter_case(title, false)
        match seen_titles.get(title_key)
            string prior
                messages = messages.append("same title as " + prior)
            none
                .seen_titles.set(title_key, entry.key)
        for name := unknown_fields(entry)[]
            messages = messages.append("unknown field '{name}'")
        for message := messages[]
            emit("WARN {entry.key}: {message}")
        warnings += int(#messages)
    emit("CHECK warnings={warnings}")

void export_entry(const Entry entry)
    emit("@" + entry.kind + "{{" + entry.key + ",")
    string[] names := []
    for name := known_fields()[]
        if entry.fields.has(name)
            names = names.append(name)
    names = names.concat(unknown_fields(entry))
    for: index < #names
        name := names[index]
        suffix := if index + 1 == #names then "" else ","
        emit("  " + name + " = {{" + field(entry, name) + "}}" + suffix)
    emit("}}")

void statistics(const Database database)
    map<string, int> types
    map<string, int> years
    map<string, int> pairs
    distinct<string> authors
    for entry := database.entries[]
        increment(&types, entry.kind)
        increment(&years, plain(field(entry, "year")))
        if not entry.fields.has("author")
            continue
        distinct<string> unique_authors
        for person := entry.primary.names[]
            name := name_text(person, false, false)
            .authors.add(name)
            .unique_authors.add(name)
        names := unique_authors.sorted()
        for: first < #names
            for: first + 1 <= second < #names
                increment(&pairs, names[first] + HT + names[second])
    emit("ENTRIES {#database.entries}")
    for kind := types.keys().sorted()[]
        emit("TYPE {kind} {map_count(types, kind)}")
    for year := years.keys().sorted()[]
        emit("YEAR {year} {map_count(years, year)}")
    emit("AUTHORS {authors.size()}")
    best := ""
    maximum := 0
    for pair := pairs.keys().sorted()[]
        count := map_count(pairs, pair)
        if count > maximum
            best = pair
            maximum = count
    if maximum == 0
        emit("PAIR none")
    else
        names := best.split(HT)
        emit("PAIR {names[0]} & {names[1]} {maximum}")

Style | none parse_style(string name)
    if name == "APA"
        return Style.APA
    if name == "IEEE"
        return Style.IEEE
    if name == "CHICAGO"
        return Style.Chicago
    if name == "MLA"
        return Style.MLA
    return none

string[] command_words(string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    if words[0] != "CITE" and words[0] != "SEARCH"
        return words
    first := find_index(line, " ")
    if first < 0
        return words
    offset := find_index(line[first + 1:], " ")
    if offset < 0
        return words
    second := first + 1 + offset
    return [line[0:<first], line[first + 1:<second], line[second + 1:]]

void | error execute(Database &database, string line)
    words := command_words(line)
    command := words[0]
    if not includes(["FORMAT", "BIBLIOGRAPHY", "CITE", "KEYGEN", "CHECK", "SEARCH", "EXPORT", "STATS"], command)
        return error("unknown command '{command}'")
    count := int(#words) - 1
    required := if command == "FORMAT" or command == "CITE" or command == "SEARCH" then 2 elif command == "BIBLIOGRAPHY" or command == "EXPORT" then 1 else 0
    if (command == "FORMAT" and count < required) or (command != "FORMAT" and count != required)
        return error("wrong number of arguments")
    Style style := Style.APA
    if command == "FORMAT" or command == "BIBLIOGRAPHY" or command == "CITE"
        match parse_style(words[1])
            Style parsed
                style = parsed
            none
                return error("unknown style '{words[1]}'")
    if command == "FORMAT"
        ranking := ieee_order(database)
        for key := words[2:][]
            if not database.lookup.has(key)
                emit("ERROR unknown key '{key}'")
            else
                index := map_count(database.lookup, key)
                emit(reference(database.entries[index], style, ranking.numbers[index]))
    elif command == "BIBLIOGRAPHY"
        emit(if style == Style.MLA then "Works Cited" else "References")
        ranking := ieee_order(database)
        order := if style == Style.IEEE then ranking.order else database.bibliography
        previous := -1
        for index := order[]
            repeated := previous >= 0 and (style == Style.Chicago or style == Style.MLA) and database.entries[previous].primary == database.entries[index].primary
            emit(reference(database.entries[index], style, ranking.numbers[index], repeated))
            previous = index
    elif command == "CITE"
        text := try cite(&database, style, words[2])
        emit(text)
    elif command == "KEYGEN"
        keygen(database)
    elif command == "CHECK"
        check_entries(database)
    elif command == "SEARCH"
        string[] keys := []
        needle := letter_case(words[2], false)
        for entry := database.entries[]
            if entry.fields.has(words[1]) and letter_case(plain(field(entry, words[1])), false).contains(needle)
                keys = keys.append(entry.key)
        emit(if #keys == 0 then "MATCHES 0" else "MATCHES {#keys}: " + keys.join(" "))
    elif command == "EXPORT"
        if not database.lookup.has(words[1])
            return error("unknown key '{words[1]}'")
        export_entry(database.entries[map_count(database.lookup, words[1])])
    else
        statistics(database)
    return void

    database_lines = database_lines.append(database_line)
formatter := read_database(database_lines)
int command_count
scan(&command_count)
for: 0 <= command_index < command_count
